description: AAASM-5344: clean Japanese prose — no findings. The defect class is space-less scripts generally, not Chinese specifically. Kanji share the Han byte ranges, so the kanji-dense clause here is 63 bytes at 4.81 bits/byte and trips the byte-scored gate exactly as Chinese does; a fix scoped to a zh-TW code path or to a Chinese-only test corpus would leave it firing.
